capabilities: Render the vault as a 3D graph
Highlight a note's neighbors on focus
Filter folders and tags via the legend
extras: No network requests or telemetry; everything is computed locally from Obsidian's own link index. Interface follows Obsidian's language (English or French).
problem: Obsidian's built-in graph view is flat and does not reveal folder structure or link density at a glance.
summary: 3D graph view of the vault that colors nodes by top-level folder, sizes them by link count, and highlights a note's neighbors.
